narrative.text: Merchant MID100057 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 744 days ago. Telemetry agrees: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are round_share_recent at +3.4 sigma (observed 0.538 against a category baseline of 0.139), round_share_all at +3.3 sigma (observed 0.513 against a category baseline of 0.138), chargeback_drift at -3.0 sigma (observed -0.00764 against a category baseline of 0). The checkout surface presents a unlicensed_lending interface at 0.99 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 1 independent view of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier is a merchant verification call. Settlements continue: one dissenting view is enough to ask, not to hold. A model is 0.99 confident, but only 1 independent view dissents -- model confidence is not evidence agreement, and the action reflects the latter.
